articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed; avg 11 published per cycle; 1 quarantined (Yemen Taiz)

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05, for the stage-runner refactor) bars a new one. Nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Every goal is met today. The softest is Latin America, exactly at 5% (two São Paulo stories and Haiti), up from 4%. Science at 6 clears its floor of 5, but two of the six are AI research (the Quanta proof, Goodfire), and Science, Nature and STAT are absent. Al Jazeera fell from 10 stories to 6, tied with Reuters at 10% of articles.
watching: Gulf war: Iran set six-day terms for reopening Hormuz, Lavrov went to Tehran offering to broker US–Iran talks, and Houthi missiles killed 18 at a Shabwa camp.
Russia–Ukraine: Russia hit 28 energy facilities and cut power to 550,000 households, while Putin floated a Trump–Xi summit on a Ukraine deal and reshuffled his cabinet.
Brazil's runoff: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debated, and Meta began blocking political posts.
France: curfews and a Paris protest ban follow last week's riots.
AI compute and China's model price war: Nscale's talks over a $45bn Anthropic deal, its lost Microsoft UK site, Texas pausing data-centre permits, and MiniMax undercutting DeepSeek.
Pakistan: the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister is missing, and a Sindh court upheld Mahrang Baloch's acquittal.
coverageGaps: Eleven stories carry a country or region, not a city, as their location (United States ×5, China ×2, Ghana, Germany, Massachusetts, Europe), up from ten yesterday; it still breaks the city-only dateline rule.
Africa had 5 datelines but only one hard-news story south of the Sahara outside South Africa (Kinshasa), and none from the Sahel or the Horn.
Science drew no story from Science, Nature, STAT or a health outlet; two of the six are AI research.
The Yemen Taiz advance story was quarantined (.bad), so the Saudi–Yemen front has only the Shabwa strike today.
context: All five cycles completed, averaging 984s (selector 159s, writer 160s, editor 56s). One story rests only on state or advocacy sources (the Philippines data-centre protests), down from four, allowed and labelled. Oceania returned with two datelines (Wangaratta, Tocal) after five days without one. Multi-source held at 36% after 40% yesterday.
